description: Report the state of the local ProphetKey proxy: whether it is running, its port (default 1421), how many keys are loaded, and the total number of requests handled. Use this to diagnose connectivity before calling prophetkey_make_request, or to confirm the proxy is up after the desktop app starts. Read-only, takes no arguments, and makes no provider calls; if the desktop app is not running it returns running=false rather than an error.
name: prophetkey_proxy_status
title: Get proxy status
